name: Crystal Pools & Spas
description: A bright poolside-blue theme for pool and spa cleaning and service businesses: a glossy waterline tile band with painted depth markers, weekly maintenance plans as deep-end markers, a water clarity comparator that points green pools to the right rescue, a test-kit chart of ideal water ranges, repairs from pumps to heaters, route days by city, phone hours and a Jamstacks contact component for plan, repair and rescue enquiries.
